items.title: Rampzalige seizoensstart Lazio: Taylor en co in beker onderuit tegen Serie B-ploeg
items.summary: Lazio is het seizoen begonnen met een fikse domper. De Romeinen, met Kenneth Taylor en Danilho Doekhi in de basis, werden in de eerste ronde van de Coppa Italia direct uitgeschakeld. Serie B-ploeg Mantova bleek een maatje te groot.

items.title: Arteta looft nieuwkomer Tzolis na succesvol debuut
items.summary: Christos Tzolis kwam deze zomer voor zo'n veertig miljoen euro over van Club Brugge en speelde direct een grote rol bij zijn nieuwe werkgever Arsenal. The Gunners wonnen het Community Shield op overtuigende wijze van Manchester City (3-0) met een hoofdrol voor de nieuwkomer. De ex-Twente-speler Tzolis was twee keer de aangever bij een goal en kon daarvoor op de nodige complimenten rekenen van zijn manager Mikel Arteta.

items.title: Verdeeldheid over overtreding Bouwman op Vente: 'Dit is gewoon een rode kaart'
items.summary: De gele kaart die Aaron Bouwman zondag ontving tijdens het gelijkspel tegen SC Heerenveen doet het nodige stof opwaaien. De verdediger van Ajax ging op de bon nadat hij Dylan Vente in het gezicht had geraakt. Dat had hem ook rood kunnen opleveren, zo concluderen de analytici van ESPN.

items.title: VI Live: blamage dreigt voor Taylor en Lazio
items.summary: Zowel in binnen- als buitenland wordt er zondag volop gevoetbald. In de Eredivisie staan er vier duels op het programma, waarvan de potjes van Feyenoord en PSV een eigen liveblog hebben. In Engeland strijden Arsenal en Manchester City om het Community Shield. Blijf op de hoogte in deze VI Live.

items.title: Rodri set to complete Barcelona move after Manchester City accept £65.4m bid
items.summary: 30-year-old said to favour a move back to Spain Maresca chasing Lille’s Bouaddi as replacement Rodri looks set to complete a move to Barcelona after Manchester City accepted a bid of £65.4m from the Spanish club. The 30-year-old World Cup winner had entered the final year of his contract at the Etihad Stadium and made it clear he would like the opportunity to move to Barcelona. City, who are now closing in on a deal to sign Lille’s Ayyoub Bouaddi, were reluctant sellers but had little choice with the Spanish international out of contract next summer. Continue reading...

items.summary: RC Lens heeft beslag gelegd op de Trophée des Champions. Ondanks een vroege rode kaart hield het tiental van de seizoensrevelatie van vorig jaar knap stand. Het sterrenensemble van Champions League-winnaar Paris Saint-Germain kwam er niet aan te pas: 1-0.

items.title: Flemming’s dramatic Burnley double pegs back West Ham on Championship return
items.summary: There are many good reasons why Burnley and West Ham are performing as Premier League tribute acts, slumming it in the Championship with the hope of a shot at the limelight once more. They are two flawed teams, relegated because of chronic defects, and plenty were on show as West Ham blew a two-goal lead to start life on the second-tier circuit with an entertaining draw. Zian Flemming’s late double secured a thoroughly deserved point for the hosts, who showed promise going forward but took far too long to find a clinical finish. Despite going two goals ahead through Maximilian Kilman and Manor Solomon, West Ham rarely looked comfortable as they sat back, something that eventually cost them. Continue reading...

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo says this year is ‘probably’ his last as a footballer
items.summary: Al-Nassr and Portugal forward expects to retire soon Ronaldo has more than 950 goals for club and country Cristiano Ronaldo believes this year is “probably” his last as a professional footballer, the 41-year-old Portugal captain said in an interview with Vogue magazine published on Sunday. Ronaldo, who has established his place among football’s all-time greats with more than 950 goals for club and country, had previously spoken of retiring “soon” or within “one or two years”. Continue reading...

items.title: Calafiori’s fast start inspires Arsenal to big Community Shield win over Manchester City
items.summary: For Enzo Maresca, a miserable first meaningful game in charge of Manchester City that began with Arsenal seizing the lead after 24 seconds ended with Mikel Arteta’s side ­lifting the Community Shield. Arsenal eviscerated City, Riccardo Calafiori’s smart early opener after Myles Lewis-­Skelly’s brilliant pass ­seemingly leaving their opponents with irrecoverable damage. Kai Havertz doubled Arsenal’s lead on 28 ­minutes and Martin Ødegaard in effect sealed the win three minutes into the ­second half, taking great ­pleasure in ­fooling ­Gianluigi ­Donnarumma in the City goal before finishing. On this evidence, the post-Pep ­Guardiola era could be trickier than widely envisaged. Christos Tzolis shone on the left, playing the whole game in Cardiff. He was involved in all three goals, assisting two. No Arsenal player played more passes into the final third. It was Tzolis’s cross to switch play to Noni Madueke, one of 10 passes before Calafiori rippled the City net. Between Lewis-Skelly rolling the ball to Martin Ødegaard at kick-off and Calafiori peeling off Abdukodir Khusanov to finish, City had a single touch of the ball; Elliot Anderson intercepted Calafiori’s pass aimed at Ødegaard in the City 18-yard box. But then Madueke cushioned a header for Ben White, who tucked into midfield, and Lewis-Skelly rolled Phil Foden before releasing Calafiori goal-side of Rúben Dias with a sumptuous reverse ball. Continue reading...

items.title: Nabizada stunner edges Watford past Southampton as ‘Spygate’ still looms large
items.summary: Southampton will have to get used to being barracked as they travel the Championship this autumn, the “Spygate” team set to be everyone’s favourite boo boys in the second tier. Certainly that was the case in Hertfordshire, with Watford fans and players alike beside themselves after a hard-fought victory, decided by two memorable first-half goals. Tonda Eckert, the Southampton head coach, remains under investigation for his part in the Spygate affair and presented a subdued figure both during and after this contest. He insisted that his team were more united than ever after suffering the indignity of being removed from last season’s playoffs, “but it would be easier to say that after a victory”, Eckert acknowledged. Continue reading...
